title: FuncMage
note: Subject v2.1. Each file is imported and its functions are called on our own data: return values, closures, decorators and the exact strings the subject quotes ("* name *", "Spell fizzled", "Memory not found", "Insufficient power for this spell", "Spell casting failed after N attempts", "Successfully cast X with N power") must match. Each script must run without crashing; its output is only compared to the subject example as a warning (4.4: messages may be customized). Source: the subject's signatures, lambda + sorted / filter / map / max / min in ex0, functools.reduce + operator, functools.partial, lru_cache, singledispatch in ex3, functools.wraps in ex4, closures without global, functools / operator only where authorized, Callable from collections.abc, no eval / exec / open(), type hints, flake8 (the subject does not ask for mypy). Warnings: builtins outside the 'Authorized:' line of ex0 / ex1, other standard modules, module-level variables.

forbid_nodes.Global: global statement (subject 4.3: global variables are forbidden)

tests.name: conditional_caster(): casts only when the condition is True, else "Spell fizzled"
code: assert err is None, '%s raised %s: %s' % (desc, type(err).__name__, err)
cast = run('conditional_caster(strong, fireball)', m.conditional_caster, strong, fireball)
assert callable(cast), 'conditional_caster(strong, fireball) must return a function, got %r' % (cast,)
assert log == [] and seen == [], 'conditional_caster() must not call anything itself: calls %r %r' % (seen, log)
for target, power, ok in (('Dragon', 25, True), ('Dragon', 20, True), ('Goblin', 5, False), ('Orc', 19, False), ('Wyvern', 100, True)):
got = run('conditional_caster(strong, fireball)(%r, %r)' % (target, power), cast, target, power)
want = 'Fireball hits %s for %s damage' % (target, power) if ok else 'Spell fizzled'
assert got == want, 'conditional_caster(<power >= 20>, fireball)(%r, %r)\n  expected %r\n  got      %r' % (target, power, want, got)
assert seen == [(target, power)], 'the condition must receive the same arguments (%r, %r): calls %r' % (target, power, seen)
assert log == [('fireball', target, power)], 'the spell must be cast once with (%r, %r): calls %r' % (target, power, log)
assert log == [], 'condition False: the spell must not be cast at all, calls %r' % log
never = m.conditional_caster(lambda t, p: False, heal)
assert got == 'Spell fizzled', "conditional_caster(<always False>, heal)('Elf', 50)\n  expected 'Spell fizzled'\n  got      %r" % (got,)
